ITEM 1 | Pale green, wilted leafy vegetable with ruffled, broad flat leaves and pale white-green stems, spread across the right half of a white square plate; glossy and coated with a creamy pale-yellow sauce that clings to the leaves, with a few pale golden-tan flakes or shards scattered through it, soft and limp with no distinct shape, roughly 14 cm across and 1.5 cm thick | 150

ITEM 2 | Pale golden-tan thin shavings or flakes, irregular and flat, scattered over and among the leafy greens in the upper-right portion of the plate, dry-looking with slight edge curl, about 0.3 cm thick and 1 to 3 cm across | 20

ITEM 3 | Bright green slender beans, cooked until soft and slightly glossy with a dull sheen, arranged in a loose heap on the left side of the plate, each about 6 to 8 cm long and 0.5 cm thick, some with dark tips and stem ends trimmed, lying next to the creamy greens with no sauce on them | 70

ITEM 4 | Creamy pale-yellow sauce coating the leafy greens, smooth and thick, visible as a glossy film on the leaves and pooling slightly in the folds on the right side of the plate | 15
